description: Defines a template class Interval<T> representing a half-open interval with operations such as containment, intersection, union, and difference. Includes implementation of methods and operators for interval manipulation.

classes.name: Interval<T>
classes.description: A template class representing a half-open interval [min, max) with various interval operations.

methods.name: Interval(const T& min, const T& max)
methods.description: Constructs an interval with specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: min()
methods.description: Returns the minimum bound of the interval.

methods.name: max()
methods.description: Returns the maximum bound of the interval.

methods.name: Set(const T& min, const T& max)
methods.description: Sets both min and max bounds.

methods.name: CopyFrom(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Copies interval data from another interval.

methods.name: Empty()
methods.description: Checks if the interval is empty (max <= min).

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the interval (max - min).

methods.name: Contains(const T& t)
methods.description: Checks if a point is within the interval.

methods.name: Contains(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Checks if this interval fully contains another interval.

methods.name: Intersects(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Checks if this interval intersects with another.

methods.name: Intersects(const Interval& i, Interval* out)
methods.description: Checks intersection and outputs the intersecting interval.

methods.name: IntersectWith(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Modifies this interval to be its intersection with another.

methods.name: SpanningUnion(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Expands this interval to include another, if necessary.

methods.name: Difference(const Interval& i, Interval* lo, Interval* hi)
methods.description: Calculates the difference between intervals, outputting up to two intervals.
